title: §.IX German: Estates keep the Apology printed at Wittenberg and delivered with the improved Confession at Worms 1540
pass_a_gloss: Likewise we also hereby affirm the Apology which through our ancestors and partly through us was presented at the said Imperial Diet at Augsburg but which they would not accept, as the same was afterward printed at Wittenberg and at the said Colloquy at Worms in the year 1540 was handed over beside the aforementioned improved Confession, expressly repeated and we have confessed ourselves to it.
pass_b_english: Likewise we hereby also hold the Apology which our ancestors — and partly we ourselves — presented at that Augsburg Diet, though it was not accepted; afterward it was printed at Wittenberg, and at the Worms Colloquy in 1540 it was delivered beside the improved Confession already named — expressly repeated, and we have confessed ourselves to it.
source_text: Gleichergestalt wollen wir auch hiemit die Apologi/ so durch unsere Vorfahren/ und zum theil uns /auf gemeltem Reichs Tag zu Augspurg/ überreichet / aber man nicht hat annehmen wollen/wie die selbige hernach zu Wittenberg gedruckt/und auf gedachtem Colloquio zu Wormbs A. 1540. neben obberührten verbesserten Confession übergeben / ausdrucklich repetirt und uns darzu bekennt haben.

choices.why: German wording for the revised AC at Worms 1540
